Rangers vs Aberdeen; Scottish Premiership
Rangers vs Aberdeen. Scottish Premiership.
Ibrox StadiumAttendance50,738.
Rangers 3-2 Aberdeen: Gers beat Dons in five-goal thriller to cut Celtic's Premiership lead to one point
Report as Rangers beat Aberdeen at Ibrox; Brad Lyons gave Aberdeen a surprise lead; Ryan Naderi, Djeidi Gassama and Nico Raskin hit back after the break; Findlay Marshall fired the Dons back into the game; the Ibrox side are one point behind Premiership leaders Celtic
Tuesday 24 November 2026 22:25, UK
Rangers are just one point behind in the Premiership title race after a dramatic fightback against a rejuvenated Aberdeen.
Derek McInnes' side needed to win their game in hand to cut Celtic's lead at the top of the table, but did not get it all their own way on a rainy night in Govan.
After Dan Neil and Ryan Naderi came close, Aberdeen took a shock lead to silence Ibrox. Nico Raskin thought he had cleared Brad Lyons header, but VAR confirmed the ball was already over the line.

Ivor Pandur's brilliant stop denied Ayoub Mouloua a second for the Dons before a triple half-time change sent the hosts on their way to victory.
Minsu Kim's first involvement resulted in the equaliser as Marius Muller spilled his shot into Ryan Naderi's path and he made no mistake.
Just 65 seconds later, Rangers were in front when Djeidi Gassama fired Naderi's ball into the net. Nico Raskin slotted in a third, but Findlay Marshall's wonderful strike pulled Mario Frick's side back into the game with Pandur pulling off another brilliant stop to make sure the three points stayed in Glasgow.
Rangers can move top of the Premiership on Saturday if they can halt Falkirk's winning run. Aberdeen remain eighth.
More to follow...
The key moments from Ibrox
2: CLOSE! James Penrice sends in a brilliant cross, but both Dan Neil and Ryan Naderi fail to turn it into the net.
4: CHANCE! Djeidi Gassama makes a brilliant run, then decides to cross the ball to Badredine Bouanani who fails to make contact.
30: OFF THE LINE! Findlay Marshall sends the ball into Brad Lyons. Nico Raskin clears is off the line, but was the ball in?
30: GOAL ABERDEEN! It was over the line and the Dons are in front!
38: SAVE! Almost a second for Aberdeen! Ayoub Mouloua is one-on-one with Ivor Pandur and keeper manages to tip it away.
47: GOAL RANGERS! Marius Muller can't hold on to Minsu Kim's shot. It's straight into Naderi's path and he makes no mistake.
48: GOAL RANGERS! Naderi with the assist this time as he sends a lovely ball to Gassama to fire into the far corner.
56: GOAL RANGERS! Aberdeen are caught on the break. Gassama runs the length of the pitch and sets up Raskin to fire through Muller's legs.
58: GOAL ABERDEEN! Marshall's left-footed strike goes in off the post and the Dons are back in this.
62: SAVE! What a stop from Pandur to stop Aberdeen pulling level as he reacts to stop their corner from hitting the back of the net.
90+3: BIG MISS! For Rangers. Kim pounces on the loose ball, cuts inside to avoid the defender but curls his shot wide of the target.
digest_he:
קבוצת ריינג'רס רשמה מהפך דרמטי וניצחה 2-3 את אברדין באצטדיון אייברוקס, תוצאה שמקרבת אותה כדי נקודה אחת בלבד מסלטיק המובילה את טבלת הליגה הסקוטית. המשחק החל בהפתעה גמורה כאשר ברד ליאונס כבש לזכות אברדין, לאחר בדיקת VAR שאישרה כי הכדור עבר את קו השער. האורחות אף כמעט הכפילו את יתרונם, אך שוער ריינג'רס איבור פנדור הציל שער בטוח.

עם פתיחת המחצית השנייה ביצעה ריינג'רס חילופים שהובילו למהפך מהיר. ריאן נדרי השווה את התוצאה בדקה ה-47, ודג'יידי גאסאמה כבש שער יתרון כעבור 65 שניות בלבד. ניקו ראסקין הוסיף את השער השלישי למארחים, ועל אף שפינדלי מרשל צימק את התוצאה עבור אברדין, ריינג'רס שמרה על היתרון עד לסיום והבטיחה את מלוא הנקודות.
